text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Natto, soy milk, toner with soy 
isoflavones... These gifts from Universe 
and Earth... Aren't they all—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's all things that are good for the 
skin...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's true that my skin has been stinging a 
lot lately... Did I... make you worry 
about me...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. To give them peace of mind, I 
have to turn the care they gave me into 
good health.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa steels her resolve. However, 
it seems it will still take a bit more 
time for the isoflavones' effects to show 
on her skin.
